title: Alchemists in Arcane Study
description: Two hooded figures sit at a wooden table in a stone chamber filled with astronomical diagrams. One figure in white robes examines a pile of dark material and gold coins while the other in black robes tends to a smoking alchemical vessel, with an open spellbook, lit candle, and moonlit arched window visible.
